judged_text: The slug condition is inverted: the old `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` set the slug when billing was disabled, the new `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})` sets it only when billing is enabled On every self-hosted/default deployment (IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED=false), organization creation succeeds but persists no slug, so the newly created org is unreachable at its /org/<slug> URL and any code reading organization.slug gets null — an operation that returns success while dropping required work

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts`, the PR changes the organization `create` payload from `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`. This indeed flips the condition: when `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` is false, the `slug` field is no longer written at all (and `requestedSlug` is also only set when enabled). From the diff alone, this means org creation under the default/false flag will persist no slug unless some unseen DB/default logic fills it, which is a concrete behavioral regression risk consistent with the finding.
